# OpenForum Project Context

Before making architectural or implementation decisions in this repository, review [docs/Architecture.md](../docs/Architecture.md) for the current system design, module boundaries, data flow, and deployment assumptions.

Use the [docs](../docs) folder as the source of truth for project planning and operational context. In particular, check [docs/tickets](../docs/tickets) for active, backlog, and completed work before changing behavior tied to an existing ticket.

Keep changes aligned with the documented architecture and update the relevant docs when a change intentionally alters architecture, operational behavior, setup, or ticket scope.

Before creating or editing any ticket, read the current [ticket template](../docs/tickets/_template.md) and follow its conventions. Keep guidance comments and placeholder instructions in the template only; real tickets should contain ticket-specific content.
